learn.title: Wind Turbine Lifespan & Recycling
learn.intro: Wind turbines last 20-25 years, but blades become waste. Recycling extends sustainability, reduces landfill, and supports circular economy. IRENA reports 90% of turbine materials are recyclable, making end-of-life management critical for India's 60 GW wind target by 2030.
learn.c1_text: Turbines operate 20-25 years with regular maintenance. Sensors monitor gearbox oil, blade stress, and pitch systems. Predictive analytics reduce downtime by 30%, ensuring optimal energy capture. India's 100 GW renewable target depends on maximizing turbine uptime.
learn.c2_text: Blades are shredded into fibers for cement production or reprocessed into new composites. Mechanical grinding recovers 80-90% of materials. IRENA's 2023 report highlights chemical recycling breakthroughs enabling 100% recyclability for future turbines.
learn.c3_text: India's 2023 Wind Energy Policy mandates 90% recyclability for new turbines. Gujarat's Vestas plant pioneered blade-to-cement recycling, processing 1,000 blades annually. Tamil Nadu's wind parks now integrate recycling hubs, aligning with 500 MW annual decommissioning projections by 2030.

learn.title: Perovskite Solar Cells Innovation
learn.intro: Perovskite solar cells achieve 33% efficiency, surpassing silicon's 26% ceiling. Their low-cost manufacturing and tunable absorption spectra promise cheaper, flexible panels. NREL's 2024 breakthrough accelerates India's 280 GW solar mission by 2030 through next-gen tech adoption.
learn.c1_text: Perovskites are organic-inorganic crystals with exceptional light absorption. NREL's 2023 tandem cells hit 33% efficiency by stacking perovskite on silicon. Their defect-tolerant design enables high performance at lower costs, ideal for India's 5 million rooftop solar target.
learn.c2_text: Perovskites print like ink, slashing production costs by 50% vs. silicon wafers. Solution-processing enables flexible panels for buildings and vehicles. Stability improvements now exceed 25-year lifespans, addressing early degradation concerns for utility-scale deployment.
learn.c3_text: IIT Madras' 2024 perovskite pilot plant targets 15% efficiency for rural microgrids. The National Solar Mission incentivizes 20% cost reduction via emerging tech. Gujarat's Solar Park integrates perovskite-silicon hybrids, projecting 1.5 GW deployment by 2030.

learn.title: Small Wind Turbines Explained
learn.intro: Small wind turbines (<100 kW) power homes and communities affordably. Unlike giants, they work in low winds (3-12 m/s) and integrate with batteries. US DOE confirms 40% ROI for rural India's 50,000 km² wind potential, democratizing energy access.
learn.c1_text: Small turbines use horizontal/vertical blades connected to generators. Cut-in speed is 3 m/s, optimal at 8-10 m/s. Anemometers track wind direction. India's 3-15 m/s average wind zones make 5-50 kW systems viable for villages and farms.
learn.c2_text: Towers raise blades to 10-30m for stronger winds. Systems pair with batteries for 24/7 power. US DOE notes 10-20% grid offset for homes. In Rajasthan, 10 kW turbines cut diesel costs by 70% for remote clinics.
learn.c3_text: Gujarat's Kutch district installed 500 small turbines for 20,000 homes. Tamil Nadu's pumps run 100% on wind, saving 1.5 million liters/day diesel. MNRE subsidies cover 30-40% costs, enabling 1,000 new projects annually under the 500 MW target.

learn.title: Smart Grids & Digital Meters
learn.intro: Smart grids use digital meters and AI to balance supply-demand dynamically. IEA reports 90% renewable integration requires smart systems. India's $200 billion grid modernization cuts losses from 20% to 10%, enabling 500 GW clean energy by 2030.
learn.c1_text: Advanced meters record usage every 15 minutes, enabling time-of-use pricing. Two-way communication alerts utilities to outages instantly. India's 250 million smart meters (2024 target) reduce theft losses worth $10 billion annually in states like Uttar Pradesh.
learn.c2_text: AI forecasts demand and weather, optimizing renewable dispatch. Sensors detect faults in seconds, cutting blackout duration by 50%. IEA notes smart grids lower curtailment by 15%, vital for India's 500 GW renewable surge and 24/7 power promise.
learn.c3_text: Rural electrification uses microgrids with IoT sensors. Karnataka's pilot saved 1.2 billion kWh/year via demand response. The National Smart Grid Mission aims for 100% coverage by 2030, integrating 200 GW solar/wind with battery storage.

learn.title: Flow Batteries for Grid Storage
learn.intro: Flow batteries store energy in liquid electrolytes, offering 20,000+ cycles and 10+ hour duration. DOE highlights vanadium systems' grid-scale potential for India's 500 GW renewable shift, enabling 24/7 clean power and reducing coal dependency by 30% by 2035.
learn.c1_text: Vanadium redox batteries use V⁺⁺/V⁺³ electrolytes, providing 1.5-2.5 hours duration. Iron-based systems use cheaper Fe²⁺/Fe³⁺, lasting 15,000 cycles. Both scale easily by enlarging tanks, ideal for 100 MW+ projects needing daily grid balancing.
learn.c2_text: Flow batteries discharge for 8-12 hours, unlike lithium's 4-hour limit. DOE's 2024 report confirms 50% cost drop by 2030. Gujarat's 100 MWh vanadium pilot stabilizes 500 MW solar farms, preventing 100 MW annual curtailment through 6-hour storage.
learn.c3_text: National Energy Storage Mission targets 500 MWh by 2025. Andhra Pradesh's 50 MW iron-flow plant supports 200 MW wind-solar hybrids. MNRE subsidies cover 40% costs, enabling 50 grid-scale projects (2024) to meet 24/7 power for 10 million homes.

learn.title: HVDC Transmission Lines
learn.intro: HVDC lines transmit power 1,000+ km with 30% less loss than AC, vital for India's 200 GW solar/wind in remote zones. IEA confirms HVDC cuts costs by 50% for long-distance projects, enabling 500 GW integration and 24/7 clean energy access by 2035.
learn.c1_text: HVDC uses single-phase DC, eliminating reactive power loss. Transmission efficiency: 95% over 1,000 km vs. 85% for AC. India's 1,500 km Green Energy Corridor links 100 GW solar from Rajasthan to Delhi, saving 2.5 TWh/year in transmission losses.
learn.c2_text: Thyristors convert AC to DC at stations, costing $500 million/km. India's 2024 HVDC link uses VSC technology for underground cables. Projects like the 3,000 km China-India line aim to transmit 10 GW across borders, stabilizing grids with 50% renewable mix.
learn.c3_text: The Green Energy Corridor plans 5,000 km HVDC lines by 2030. Tamil Nadu's 1,200 km line connects 15 GW wind to northern states. With $20 billion investment, HVDC enables 24/7 solar from Gujarat's 100 GW project to power 100 million homes.
